title: Targeted anti-tumor synergistic effects of Myc decoy oligodeoxynucleotides-loaded selenium nanostructure combined with chemoradiotherapy on LNCaP prostate cancer cells.
authors: Ghorbani, Roghayeh; Gharbavi, Mahmoud; Sharafi, Ali; Rismani, Elham; Rezaeejam, Hamed; Mortazavi, Yousef; Johari, Behrooz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究负载Myc诱饵寡核苷酸的硒纳米结构联合放化疗对前列腺癌细胞的抗肿瘤效应，虽涉及ODN-DNA结合与分子对接/MD分析，但核心是药物递送与细胞实验，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: In the present study, we investigated the synergistic effects of targeted methotrexate-selenium nanostructure containing Myc decoy oligodeoxynucleotides along with X-irradiation exposure as a combination therapy on LNCaP prostate cancer cells. Myc decoy ODNs were designed based on the promoter of Bcl-2 gene and analyzed by molecular docking and molecular dynamics assays. ODNs were loaded on the synthesized Se@BSA@Chi-MTX nanostructure. The physicochemical characteristics of nanostructures were determined by FTIR, DLS, UV-vis, TEM, EDX, in vitro release, and hemolysis tests. Subsequently, the cytotoxicity properties of them with and without X-irradiation were investigated by uptake, MTT, cell cycle, apoptosis, and scratch assays on the LNCaP cell line. The results of DLS and TEM showed negative charge (-9 mV) and nanometer size (40 nm) for Se@BSA@Chi-DEC-MTX NPs, respectively. The results of FTIR, UV-vis, and EDX showed the proper interaction of different parts and the correct synthesis of nanoparticles. The results of hemolysis showed the hemocompatibility of this nanoparticle in concentrations less than 6 mg/mL. The ODNs release from the nanostructures showed a pH-dependent manner, and the release rate was 15% higher in acidic pH. The targeted Se@BSA@Chi-labeled ODN-MTX NPs were efficiently taken up by LNCaP cells by targeting the prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA). The significant synergistic effects of nanostructure (containing MTX drug) treatment along with X-irradiation showed cell growth inhibition, apoptosis induction (~57%), cell cycle arrest (G2/M phase), and migration inhibition (up to 90%) compared to the control. The results suggested that the Se@BSA@Chi-DEC-MTX NPs can potentially suppress the cell growth of LNCaP cells. This nanostructure system can be a promising approach for targeted drug delivery and chemoradiotherapy in prostate cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了含有Myc诱饵寡脱氧核苷酸（decoy oligodeoxynucleotides）的靶向甲氨蝶呤-硒纳米结构联合X射线照射作为组合疗法对LNCaP前列腺癌细胞的协同效应。Myc诱饵ODNs基于Bcl-2基因启动子设计，并通过分子对接和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 分析验证。ODNs被负载于合成的Se@BSA@Chi-MTX纳米结构上。通过FTIR、DLS、UV-vis、TEM、EDX、体外释放和溶血试验测定了纳米结构的理化特性。随后，通过摄取、MTT、细胞周期、凋亡和划痕试验，在LNCaP细胞系上研究了它们在有无X射线照射条件下的细胞毒性特性。DLS和TEM结果显示，Se@BSA@Chi-DEC-MTX NPs分别具有负电荷（-9 mV）和纳米尺寸（40 nm）。FTIR、UV-vis和EDX结果表明各组分间相互作用适当，纳米颗粒合成正确。溶血试验结果显示，该纳米颗粒在低于6 mg/mL浓度下具有血液相容性。ODNs从纳米结构中的释放呈pH依赖性，在酸性pH下释放速率高出15%。靶向Se@BSA@Chi标记ODN-MTX NPs通过靶向前列腺特异性膜抗原 (prostate-specific membrane antigen, PSMA) 被LNCaP细胞高效摄取。纳米结构（含MTX药物）处理联合X射线照射的显著协同效应显示，与对照组相比，细胞生长抑制、凋亡诱导（约57%）、细胞周期阻滞（G2/M期）和迁移抑制（高达90%）。结果表明，Se@BSA@Chi-DEC-MTX NPs可能有效抑制LNCaP细胞的生长。该纳米结构系统可成为前列腺癌治疗中靶向药物递送和放化疗联合治疗的一种有前景的方法。
